name: ironflock
description: Claude Code plugins for the IronFlock IoT platform: operate it, and build apps and widgets on it.

plugins.name: ironflock
plugins.description: Operate IronFlock: connects Claude to your IronFlock instance, in the cloud or on an appliance, through IronFlock's MCP endpoint and an API key that you enter in Claude's settings, with the skill to set up and check that connection. More skills to operate IronFlock come in later releases; the skills to build apps and widgets are in ironflock-dev.

plugins.name: ironflock-dev
plugins.description: Build on IronFlock: design and scaffold edge apps that keep their state in the app's tables and embed their devices' web UIs in the board, write and validate their .ironflock templates (boards and widgets, data tables, app parameters, remote-access ports, AI agents), and create, change and check the board widgets themselves (@ironflock/widget-* Lit components). Needs the ironflock plugin, which Claude Code installs with it.
